purpose: Document local registry evidence, language-specific searches and bounded anonymous geometry-route review.
assessment: The municipality’s official administrative directory identifies a Diretoria de Arrecadação, Cadastro Imobiliário e IPTU, a city-level property-tax cadastre custodian. This verifies a municipal fiscal parcel/property-record function, not a land-title registry or a public geometry service. No public geometry-only vector endpoint or parcel geometry response verified. The city’s fiscal lookup is identifier/CAPTCHA-based and was not queried.

officialPrimarySources.observation: Official city organization page identifies the property-tax cadastral directorate.
